campaign.title: Rename CASE004_CLAMP preserving semantic identity and call bindings.

initial.code:
FUNCTION CASE004_CLAMP(X)
  CASE004_CLAMP = X
  IF (X < 0) THEN
    CASE004_CLAMP = 0
  END IF
  IF (X > 33) THEN
    CASE004_CLAMP = 33
  END IF
  CASE004_CLAMP = CASE004_CLAMP
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION CASE004_ACCEPTED(X)
  CASE004_ACCEPTED = 0
  IF (CASE004_CLAMP(X) >= 15) THEN
    CASE004_ACCEPTED = 1
  END IF
  CASE004_ACCEPTED = CASE004_ACCEPTED
END FUNCTION
